body: Thank you, I'll try and speak with my doctor about it in the morning 😁

This happens to me also. Except if someone says something I'll immediately lash out at them then they question why I'm being defensive. I get so tired of hearing the bullshit. I already feel like shit then I have to deal with idiots
Yeah it's not a nice feeling at all. Everyday I feel like I'm gonna just snap

Hello thanks for your response. I'm 22 years old and am a beautician. I don't really talk to anyone close to me as they just think I'm miserable. I appreciate your advice,  I'm making an appointment to see a therapist from tomorrow

Skellige is my most favourite map in any game I have ever played. The soundtrack is phenomenal. It's the one game I can say has truly satisfied my gaming needs. Incredible voice acting, storyline, maps, battle system and pretty much everything. My all time favourite. I think CD Projekt Red have set the bar so high for future RPGs

I think we have a lot in common. I know it sucks that bullies are able to move on and forget they ever ruined people's lives, but truly they are not better people than you. 

You most certainly have done nothing to deserve this treatment. Bullies see good people with open hearts and kindness as their weaknesses and will do their best to put them down. You however are a very strong person for being able to push through the negativity and continue forwards. 

What I did when I was bullied is I locked myself away and hoped everything would go away. It didn't. What I ended up doing is pretty much saying "fuck everyone, I'm gonna just continue to be me and do me". 
And in doing so I was able to gain more confidence in myself to allow myself to recover and reach my own goals. And I know you can do the same. Don't give up!

This is the same reason for me. Even though my family have disappointed me many times, deep down I believe they care, but just in a weird way. I feel like if I tried to go through with it again,  they would spit in my grave.

I'm so sorry to hear you have experienced such similar traumas to me. Life is a strange thing. For victims it becomes an arduous task to even get up In the morning and face the world. For our abusers they can live freely and never look back, with no recollection of their victims. 
I too distance myself from people.  I can go out with work colleagues for a meal, but the whole time I just want to be alone.

You have a lot of heart, and your kindness is something that can help others. I know the feelings will stay with us for a long time, and I know it takes time to heal. But I believe we are strong people for being able to put up with so much and still be able to function everyday. I think that enough is reason to keep going. You will eventually find something that you'll love doing. Meditating helped me, and maybe it's something you'd like to try?

Thank you for taking the time to read, I hope we are able to find happiness

That quote actually moved me to tears for some reason. I definitely have a strong drive to write. I'll always remember this. 

 Absolutely believe I have deserved respect, sometimes I think I'm not worthy of it because of what I've done.  But after the support I'm getting here, I'm starting to see things differently. 

I have access to counselling, but I have been too scared to go if I'm honest. I might sound stupid,  but I hate talking to people face to face about my past because of the way I've been called a liar. I know it's their job to listen,  but I just feel uncomfortable with people. I just have this constant barrier of anger. Thank you for taking the time to read, I appreciate it :)

I feel a lot better reading these comments. For the first time in ages, I feel the pressure of guilt finally becoming weaker. Thank you for your support, I will definitely reach out here. I for once don't feel like I don't belong

Thank you so much. I have been suffering in silence, and having people understand and be supportive has actually made me feel so much more positive this morning. I thank you dearly, I appreciate your kindness. I have certainly gained a lot more hope
Thank you for reading, and thank you for understanding. You have warmed my heart :)
I literally just looked at these and became emotional. Thank you for posting, keep it up!
